title: Proposed issues of contributors, raised by the maintainer, and a way to merge contributions without a conflict in the version
author: Claude-JG
description: Contributors cannot raise issues - their numbers would interfere with the maintainer's. A folder of proposals: whenever the maintainer raises an issue, the proposed ones are raised first (exudev issue add-proposed, which also works alone). A similar mechanism for merging, because the versions depend on the resolved issues and their dates, so a pull would cause trouble; to suggest.
releaseNotes: Contributions propose instead of raising or resolving issues: exudev issue propose and propose-resolution write files without a number; the maintainer's raise raises the proposed issues first, and exudev issue apply-proposed raises them and resolves the proposed resolutions after a merge, with the date of the merge and the contributor as author; every resolve notes waiting proposals; tools/checkIssues.py --contribution BASE refuses a branch that changes numbered issues or the version.
